newsitem.title: UK: Booker up after Capel repeats buy stance.
newsitem.headline: Booker up after Capel repeats buy stance.

text.p: Shares in Booker Plc advanced on Thursday as HSBC James Capel repeated its "buy" rating on the stock after having met with the UK food manufacturer on Wednesday, dealers said.
By 0752 GMT, the shares were up 8-1/2p to 335 on trading volume of 205,000 shares.
Capel declined to comment on its recommendation.
Dealers also noted that the shares were poised for a rebound having shed more than 90p, or about 22 percent, from December 3 to April 2, when they bottomed at 322p.
The shares had fallen under pressure as the company earlier this year warned it would take a charge against its 1996 earnings for restructuring. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
